name: Iconology
storyline:
Decode the painting. Expose the suspect.

In a not so distant future…

In order to combat the rapid rise of increasingly complex and brutal criminal activity, the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department established a special, top-secret division known as the Experimental Task Force.

Their secret weapon: a cutting-edge apparatus, the White Cube, capable of rendering a suspect’s thoughts in the form of cognitive paintings.

However, deciphering the truth from abstract mental landscapes requires special talent…

Haruho Tsubakiya is an Art School university student whose parents were brutally murdered ten years ago in a crime which remains unsolved to this day. Her burning desire to find the truth and get revenge driving her forward, she is recognized for her talent in deciphering cognitive paintings, and is recruited by the Task Force as a Special Investigator.

Thus the investigation begins on a second crime scene—the suspect’s own subconscious.

Delve into criminal minds in this detective thriller visual novel!
summary: Ten years ago, her parents were brutally murdered. Dive into suspects' minds using the Brain Wave Visualization Apparatus—the White Cube. Decode motives and trauma from beautifully twisted mental landscapes to expose them. Your choices warp fate in this art analysis detective thriller visual novel!
